summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing a quarterly cash dividend of C$0.1875 per common share. The dividend is payable on October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 10, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a capital return or tender offer. The filing contains no M&A activity, strategic review, or other corporate event. It is a standard periodic disclosure from a foreign private issuer regarding an ordinary quarterly dividend payment.
